title: 'Booked and blessed': Baby Dolls turn dreams into reality at first-ever concert
summary: The Baby Dolls marked a major milestone in their careers as they staged their first-ever concert at the SkyDome on Sunday — an emotional moment for the group that had begun on "It's Showtime."
